support_policy: At 9,10,11: upward box-face contact geometry consistent with recorded signed separation and midpoint; invariant collision transforms within the existing 512-eps arithmetic bound; acyclic upward support path to table; no contacts outside that support path. Indirect paths require every link to satisfy these conditions. These are sampled static-equilibrium inferences, not invented support-force measurements.
absence_policy: All 9,10,11 complete: no external object contact and geometric separation from table collision envelope. Missing contacts or merely absent support candidates are not sufficient.
event_policy: Preserve history across frame 10. A fall requires lost table-support ancestry, two consecutive completely contact-free saved endpoints with every matched collision vertex descending beyond arithmetic error, and separation from former table support. A robot lift requires exclusive bilateral contacts, upward object and both-finger co-motion and table separation; no duration rule. Drops after such observed lifts stay outside R1. Other contact losses, support changes and moving contacts remain uncertain.
negative_policy: Explicit per-frame invariant table-supported evidence, using consecutive complete snapshots, qualifies negative saved-state windows. Absence of fall candidates does not qualify any frame. Full-domain negative requires every requested saved frame qualified; unresolved movement, transitions, missing frames or post-replacement semantics cause abstention.
comparison_domain: Shared recorded saved-frame projection only: matching recording hashes, run/object/version, full requested frame range and explicit reference negative-window coverage. No continuous-time or synchronized camera-exposure equivalence is asserted. Partial negatives do not enter full-run binary counts.

event_matching.assignment: Maximum cardinality; total inclusive IoU; minimum onset distance; stable IDs. Unknown or censored endpoints do not become exact localization errors. All outside-R1 physical matching is a separate diagnostic, never R1 TP/FN.

exposure_disclosure: Development-selected cases and approved reference known from v2 task and regression scenario requirements. No labels are checker inputs. One v3 empirical execution after code/config freeze; no tuning against its scores.
